Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: one natural metallic NICKEL ASTEROID for classic1990s Tycoon pixel-art game. Four genuine yaw views of the SAME rigid natural rock, fixed2:1 isometric camera, fixed upper-left SCREEN light. EXACT BODY: a broad blunt irregular rear lobe, a smaller tapered forward beak, shallow saddle joining them. One broken SILVER mineral seam on the upper RIGHT shoulder of the main rear lobe, and one shallow dark depression on the opposite upper LEFT shoulder. Same silhouette volume, beak, saddle and seam/depression landmarks in every actual physical yaw. No spacecraft, machinery, probe, base, satellites, separate stones, crystals, ice, rings, plume, glow, orbit, floor or cast shadow. Natural dense solid ore-bearing rock.
Four independent views2x2: TOP LEFT N=small beak pointsUP/away; TOP RIGHT NE=beak upperRIGHT; BOTTOM LEFT E=beak RIGHT; BOTTOM RIGHT SE=beak lowerRIGHT/toward viewer. Turn the actual3D body relative to the fixed camera; never rotate a flat drawing or change screen lighting. Maintain consistent actual body size, each whole rock roughly400-440px wide and240-275px tall. Subtle facet clusters should remain legible when uniformly reduced to about80x55native pixels.
